race.comment: NOBLER (8) was fantastic winning second up at Flemington, settling off speed and charging home having chased Perisher first up at Rosehill. Drops down to the minimum of 54kg which should suit this horse and the wide draw should be fine, especially late in the day. He can go right on with it. ROULETTE KING (11) was much better second up when finishing midfield under the big weight. He'll improve again to 1800m now and comes right into the mix after some key scratchings. CILACAP (4) was an eye-catcher when resuming in G2 company at Flemington early last month but couldn't go with them in the Empire Rose last time. Has been given a month between runs and gets her first look at this sort of trip. A Cranbourne jumpout win has kept her up to the mark and she holds some appeal. MAKDANE (5) is rock-hard fit and gets in light with Williams reuniting. Not dismissing.
